components.name: EnvironmentVariableSource
components.contract: A dictionary that reads configuration values from environment variables with a specified prefix. Keys are converted to lowercase and '__' is replaced with nested keys. Values are converted to the appropriate scalar type.

components.name: ConfigurationEnvironmentMixin
components.contract: A mixin class for Configuration that adds methods to set environment variable sources with a specified prefix. The environment variable source has higher priority than file sources.
